name: Jiyan

tierList.prydwen: T1.5 Tower of Adversity, T1.5 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Aero Broadblade Hypercarry, one of the earliest standard-banner 5-stars, still top-tier. Ultimate transforms him into 'Qingloong Mode' (increased interruption resistance, Basic/Heavy/Dodge Counter replaced by an 8-hit-per-cast 'Lance of Qingloong' Heavy Attack combo that groups and CCs enemies). Forte 'Resolve' (max 60) empowers Skill or the Ultimate's opening draconic strike.

skills.normalAttack: Lone Lance - 5-hit chain (rarely used outside Ultimate).
skills.resonanceSkill: Windqueller - forward dash Aero DMG, low cooldown, generates lots of Resonance Energy.
skills.forte: Qingloong at War - governs Resolve spend on enhanced Skill (+20% DMG) or enhanced Ultimate opener (Emerald Storm: Finale).
skills.liberation: Emerald Storm: Prelude - enters Qingloong Mode (his entire damage window).
skills.intro: Tactical Strike - aerial Aero DMG stab.
skills.outro: Discipline - next character's Heavy Attacks trigger Qingloong Coordinated Attacks (313% ATK) for 8s, up to 2x.

echoSet: Windward Pilgrimage (best with an Aero Erosion applier)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Iuno is his best Heavy-DMG buffer; Ciaccona's Aero Erosion buffs don't expire on swap, letting Jiyan switch mid-Lance combo.

teams.name: Erosion Team
teams.notes: Very strong in quickswap, roughly equal to the Best Team.

rotation: Warm-up: Skill on cooldown, Echo right before Ultimate. Burst: Intro -> Forte (Emerald Storm) -> Lance of Qingloong P1 (interrupt via Skill) -> Skill -> Lance x6-7 -> Skill -> Outro. Advanced 'Double Dragon' combo uses dodge-cancels to overlap two Lance of Qingloong dragons simultaneously for higher DPS.
communityNotes: Prydwen: enduring top-tier AoE+ST Hypercarry DPS, easy to play, near entirely reliant on his Ultimate window for damage (little value from swap-cancelling); needs good Energy Regen/cooldown management to keep the Ultimate up every rotation. Consistently one of the best Tower of Adversity DPS since release.
